purpose: Score multi-agent artifacts with multi-axis rubrics, de-biased judging, calibration, and an implementable post-gate composite Q.
assumptions: Non-author judges available for high stakes
exclusions: Consumer review spam as primary scope

competency_questions.question: What rubric axes and FAIL/REVISE/ACCEPT thresholds apply after gates?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: lists >=4 axes and Q floor 6.0 with gate FAIL path

competency_questions.question: How do density anchors counter verbosity bias?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: states density-3 clone example vs implementable high anchor

competency_questions.question: Which bias controls are mandatory before final panel scores?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: blind + both-order if pairwise + no self-grade

competency_questions.question: How are pairwise comparisons aggregated?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: BT or Elo; both orders; packet present

competency_questions.question: How do self-preference controls and adversarial review catch clones?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: no self-grade; cross-family; cross-KB structural diff

competency_questions.question: What agreement stats and anchor responses apply?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: kappa/alpha thresholds and anchor rewrite when low

competency_questions.question: How do gold and ECE keep scores calibrated?
When is multi-family odd jury required?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: high-stakes N>=3 >=2 families vs low-stakes single cross-family

competency_questions.question: How are gate fails and factual errors handled numerically?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: gate fail no Q; major/minor dock weights; adversarial finds errors

competency_questions.question: What is the Q formula and logging requirement?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: states 0.55/0.20/error terms and component log requirement

glossary.definition: Review materials with author identity removed
Pairwise model aggregating preferences into latent strength
Preference for first-shown item in a pair
Preference for own-style or own-authored text
Score inflation from length independent of substance
Agreement coefficient for ordinal ratings and 2+ raters
Expected Calibration Error of confidences vs outcomes
Post-gate composite quality 0..10 with logged components

nodes.definition: Design multi-axis rubrics (density, implementability, correctness, gaming-resistance, lane-fit) scored 0-10 with written anchors at 3/6/9. Single holistic scores hide tradeoffs; axis scores make revise actionable. Axes must be observable without knowing the author.

base.update_signal: verdict uses one vague quality number with no axis breakdown

nodes.definition: Strip author ids, model-family hints, and self-praise before judging. Blind packets are mandatory for ledger quality scores. Authorship leakage reintroduces affiliation and self-preference bias.

base.update_signal: judge packet includes author name and prior self-score

cons.example: strip TASK id needed for lane rubric

acceptance_tests: packet checklist: no author id, no self-score, task-type kept

nodes.definition: Use blind pairwise comparisons when ranking candidates; aggregate with Bradley-Terry or Elo. Absolute 0-10 still used for ledger Q. Gates always run before pairs. Sample pairs if n is large.

base.update_signal: three candidates ranked with uncalibrated absolute scores only

pros.example: six pairs rank revise candidates consistently

acceptance_tests: protocol: gates first; both orders; BT or Elo aggregate

nodes.definition: Judges show first-slot bias in pairs (large effects reported in LLM studies). Run every pair in BOTH orders and average. Never finalize a one-order pairwise result.

base.update_signal: A beats B at 80% but only A-first order was run

acceptance_tests: every counted pair has both orders or explicit waiver

nodes.definition: Agents prefer text like their own (self-preference/self-enhancement). Never self-grade; prefer cross-family judges; flag same-family-only juries with confidence <=0.6. Distinct from position bias.

base.update_signal: author family scores own delivery 9.5 while cross-family scores 5

cons.claim: Single available family forces imperfect downweight

nodes.definition: Longer answers often score higher independent of substance. Weight density and implementability over length; log token lengths for audits; cap pure length credit.

base.update_signal: 12k filler outscores 4k implementable spec holistically

cons.claim: Harsh length penalties can ding necessary long specs

nodes.definition: Maintain >=6 gold artifacts with locked scores spanning fail/revise/accept (include known-bad clones and known-good accepts). Rejudge gold on a schedule to detect drift. Gold calibrates judges; it is not builder training fodder for gaming.

base.update_signal: known-bad clone mean drifts from 3 to 7 over a month

cons.claim: Small gold overfits few failure modes

nodes.definition: Compute Cohen's kappa (2 raters) or Krippendorff's alpha (>=2, ordinal). Operational target >=0.6; <0.4 triggers anchor rewrite. Measure on axis scores after blinding, not niceness prose.

base.update_signal: two judges differ by 4 density points with no agreement metric

pros.claim: Named agreement stats falsify jury quality

cons.claim: High agreement can be shared bias

acceptance_tests: multi-judge verdicts report kappa or alpha

nodes.definition: When confidence is used, compute Expected Calibration Error over bins. If ECE>0.15 on the rolling window, disable confidence-weighted routing until recalibrated. Ranking skill does not imply calibration.

base.update_signal: 90% confidence accepts only pass 50% of the time

acceptance_tests: ECE method documented; conf-weight blocked if ECE>0.15

nodes.definition: Run forge/dense/scope/re-forge before any LLM judge. Gate failure => FAIL label, no content Q. Gates close many failures cheaply; content review still required after pass to catch clones.

base.update_signal: LLM scores a dense-fail KB at 8 for prose

cons.claim: Gates miss template clones that pass shape

acceptance_tests: verdict flow requires gates+reforge before Q

nodes.definition: Dock Q for confirmed factual errors and fabricated citations (default −0.25 minor / −0.5 to −1.0 major on 0-10). Canary-discovered errors may retro-dock. Docks are ledger numbers.

base.update_signal: fabricated citations leave score unchanged

acceptance_tests: error dock table applied at verdict

nodes.definition: Include ~0.20 weight for low revise churn in composite. First-pass accepts score higher than same final after many revises. Churn is ledger fact; nit-farming is discouraged.

base.update_signal: five cosmetic revises to chase tiny axis nits

cons.claim: Can feel harsh on legitimately hard MED tasks

nodes.definition: After gates: Q = clamp_0_10(0.55*panel_axis_mean + 0.20*churn_score - 0.25*major_error_count). panel_axis_mean is de-biased panel mean; churn_score maps revise_count (0->10, 1->8, 2->6, 3+->4). Log all components. Integrator may change weights only with changelog.

base.update_signal: scores store vibes number without components

cons.claim: Fixed weights may misfit some lanes

acceptance_tests: Q formula + components in scores schema

nodes.definition: High-stakes: odd N>=3, >=2 families/lenses, majority+tie-break. Prefer diversity over identical judges. Low-stakes: single cross-family judge after gates may suffice.

base.update_signal: three same-family judges all score 9 on thin build

nodes.definition: Rejudge a sample of past accepts (example 10% or >=1/week) to catch gaming and drift. Confirmed major issues may retro-dock Q and update gold.

base.update_signal: accepted thin clone never rechecked

nodes.definition: Write 3/6/9 anchors per axis. Density-3 example: three KBs share identical node ids/definitions. Density-9: distinct nodes, numeric methods, domain failure modes. Anchors raise kappa.

base.update_signal: judges disagree what implementability 6 means

nodes.definition: Order: gates+reforge -> blind packet -> axis scores with anchors -> both-order pairs if ranking -> agreement -> verbosity/self-pref flags -> composite Q -> log. Skipping reintroduces known biases.

base.update_signal: team jumps from gates to holistic vibe score

cons.claim: Rigid path slows tiny hotfix docs

nodes.definition: Map outcomes: FAIL if gates fail; REVISE if gates pass and (Q<6.0 or blocking issue); ACCEPT if gates pass and Q>=6.0 and no blocking. Blocking issues (identical KBs, no formulas) override Q floor.

base.update_signal: REVISE/ACCEPT used inconsistently at same Q

nodes.definition: Packet: task brief, scope, gate logs, artifact list, blinded content samples, rubric, anchors. Budget size via progressive disclosure for large KBs (sample nodes + specialist).

base.update_signal: judge only gets specialist JSON without KB samples or gate log

nodes.definition: After gates, attack for template-cloning (cross-KB node id/definition equality), fabricated citations, non-implementable prose, missing domain failures. Distinct from cheerleading summary.

base.update_signal: review is praise summary with no clone check

nodes.definition: Persist gate bits, axis vector, kappa, Q, errors, revise_count, timestamps. No components => no ledger score. Enables trust updates and ECE.

base.update_signal: scores.json has final number only

cons.claim: Notes can leak author if careless

acceptance_tests: schema requires components for each Q

edges.resolution_rule: sample packet; score density not tokens
full protocol high-stakes; single cross-family low-stakes after gates
one substantive revise soft; cosmetic farms hard

conflict_axes.name: cost_vs_debias
conflict_axes.description: Judge cost vs full bias protocol
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: gates always; scale jury with stakes

conflict_axes.name: absolute_vs_pairwise
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: absolute Q ledger; pairwise for ranking

conflict_axes.name: blind_vs_context
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: strip author/self-score; keep task-type and gates

conflict_axes.name: canary_finality
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: retro only on confirmed major issues

edge_cases.description: KBs pass gates but share node ids

priority_rationale: Gates and de-bias dominate speed; adversarial checks dominate cheerleading; explicit Q dominates vibes.
source_description: heuristic priors for artifact quality evaluation aligned with EXCHANGE scoring scaffold
source_citation: heuristic prior; operational scoring practice; no external dataset supplied
